visualReview.method: 本地原片抽样回看；临时接触表未改原片

assets.generationPrompt: A powerful standalone Chinese fantasy game skill VFX called Sky-Splitting Sword. Pure black background, fixed side view, locked camera, one attack. A compact cyan-white light gathers at the left, then violently releases one long perfectly straight sword-shaped energy lance toward the right. Brilliant white razor core with pointed spear tip, intense electric-cyan outer flame, a brief expanding shock ring at the launch point and fine straight speed streaks. The lance dominates the horizontal composition with a forceful flash, then its trailing blue energy shreds dissolve and the image returns to black. Keep the whole lance and shock ring inside the frame with margins. No character, physical sword, scenery, text, camera movement or curved slash. Polished smooth 2D game VFX, strong crisp silhouette, dramatic focused power rather than a cloud of smoke.
